exercises.name: goblet squat
steps: 双手捧住一只哑铃贴在胸前，双脚略宽于肩，脚尖微微外八。
屈髋屈膝下蹲，膝盖顺着脚尖方向打开，蹲到能保持背部中立的最低点。
脚掌踩实地面，脚跟发力站起，站直时不要过度挺腰。
steps_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: box squat
steps: 身后放一把椅子或箱子，双脚与肩同宽。
屈髋向后坐，臀部轻触椅面后停一下，膝盖对准脚尖。
脚掌踩实站起，全程膝盖不内扣。
steps_en: Set a chair or box behind you and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until your glutes lightly touch the seat; keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Pause briefly, then drive through your feet to stand; keep your knees from caving inward.

exercises.name: glute bridge
steps: 仰卧屈膝，双脚踩地与髋同宽，脚跟离臀部约一掌。
收紧腹部，用臀部发力把髋顶起，肩到膝成一条直线。
顶点停 1 秒，慢慢放下，不要用腰代偿。
steps_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat about hip-width apart and a hand-width from your glutes.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line.
Hold for one second at the top, then lower slowly; don't arch your lower back.

exercises.name: calf raise
steps: 站直，双手各持一只哑铃，前脚掌踩实。
慢下 3 秒到脚跟接近地面，再踮起脚尖到最高点。
全程膝盖基本伸直，不要弹震。
steps_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dead bug
steps: 仰卧，双臂指向天花板，屈髋屈膝 90°，腰贴地。
对侧手和腿同时慢慢伸出，腰不要离地。
回到中间再换另一侧，动作越慢越稳。
steps_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, creating a 90-degree angle at your hips and knees.
Engage your core and lower back to press your lower back into the ground.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the ground, keeping them straight and hovering just above the floor.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell floor press
steps: 仰卧屈膝，双手各持一只哑铃，肘约 45°。
肩胛收紧贴地，把哑铃推起，手臂伸直但不锁死。
慢慢下放到上臂轻触地面，再推起。
steps_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back, then press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight but not locked.
Lower slowly until your upper arms lightly touch the floor, then press back up.

exercises.name: one arm dumbbell row
steps: 一手一膝撑在椅面上，背部保持平直，另一手持哑铃自然下垂。
肩胛先向后收，再把哑铃拉向髋部方向。
慢慢放下到手臂伸直，不要耸肩。
steps_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down towards the floor, with your arm fully extended.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: seated dumbbell shoulder press
steps: 坐在有靠背的椅子上，双手各持一只哑铃举到肩高。
背部贴住椅背，把哑铃向上推起，手臂伸直但不锁死。
慢慢下放回肩高，不要塌腰。
steps_en: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lateral raise
steps: 站直，双手各持一只轻哑铃放在身体两侧，肘微屈。
用肩膀带动手臂向两侧抬起，到与肩同高即可。
慢慢放下，不要甩、不要耸肩。
steps_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell biceps curl
steps: 站直，双手各持一只哑铃，掌心向前，肘贴近身体。
保持上臂不动，屈肘把哑铃举到肩前。
慢下 2–3 秒回到起点，不借力。
steps_en: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: bent over fly
steps: 屈髋俯身，背部平直，双手持轻哑铃自然下垂，肘微屈。
用背部发力把手臂向两侧打开，肩胛收紧。
慢慢合拢，不要用斜方肌耸肩。
steps_en: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, holding light dumbbells with slightly bent elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides by squeezing your upper back and shoulder blades.
Lower them slowly; don't shrug your traps.

exercises.name: romanian deadlift
steps: 站直，双手持哑铃贴在大腿前，膝微屈并固定。
髋向后推，哑铃贴着腿往下，背保持中立，感觉大腿后侧拉长。
臀腿发力把髋推回来，站直但不要后仰。
steps_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then push through your heels and engage your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: split squat
steps: 前后脚分开站立，重心在两脚之间。
身体垂直下沉，前腿膝盖不超过脚尖太多，后膝接近地面。
前脚踩实站起，做完一侧再换另一侧。
steps_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: plank
steps: 肘撑地，肘在肩正下方，身体从头到脚踝成一条直线。
收紧腹部和臀部，不要塌腰或撅屁股。
保持呼吸，撑到目标时间；膝痛时改跪姿。
steps_en: Set your elbows under your shoulders and extend into a straight line from head to ankles.
Brace your abs and glutes; don't let your lower back sag or your hips pike up.
Keep breathing and hold for the target time; switch to a kneeling version if your knees hurt.

exercises.name: push-up
steps: 双手略宽于肩撑地，身体成一条直线。
屈肘下放到胸口接近地面，肘约 45°。
推起还原，腰不要塌。
steps_en: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: incline push-up
steps: 双手撑在桌沿或椅面上，身体成一条直线。
屈肘下放，胸口接近支撑面。
推起还原；支撑越高越轻松。
steps_en: Place your hands on an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the elevated surface by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse lunge
steps: 站直，一条腿向后撤一大步。
身体垂直下沉，前腿膝盖对准脚尖，后膝接近地面。
前脚发力站起回到起点，换另一侧。
steps_en: Stand tall, then step one leg back into a long stride.
Lower straight down until your back knee is close to the floor, front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then switch sides.

exercises.name: step-up
steps: 面对一个稳固的低台阶或台阶。
一只脚踩上去，用上面的腿发力站起，不要蹬后脚。
慢慢下来，换另一侧。
steps_en: Face a stable low step or stair.
Place one foot on it and drive through the top leg to stand up; don't push off the back foot.
Lower slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: hip thrust
steps: 上背靠在沙发边沿，屈膝踩地，哑铃可放在髋部。
臀部发力把髋顶到与身体成一条线。
顶点停 1 秒再放下，不要用腰顶。
steps_en: Rest your upper back on the edge of a sofa with your knees bent and feet flat; a dumbbell on your hips is optional.
Squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Hold one second at the top, then lower; don't arch your lower back.

exercises.name: wall sit
steps: 背贴墙，双脚往前迈一小步，与肩同宽。
沿墙下滑到屈膝约 90°（以不痛为准）。
保持呼吸撑住，膝盖不超过脚尖。
steps_en: Stand with your back against a wall and step your feet slightly forward, hip-width apart.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees, only as far as is pain-free.
Keep breathing and hold; keep your knees behind your toes.

exercises.name: bird dog
steps: 四点跪姿，手在肩下、膝在髋下，背部平直。
对侧手和腿同时伸直，骨盆保持水平。
停 1 秒收回，换另一侧。
steps_en: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips, back flat.
Reach the opposite arm and leg out straight while keeping your pelvis level.
Hold one second, return, and switch sides.

exercises.name: side plank
steps: 侧卧，用肘和前臂撑地，肘在肩下。
把髋抬起，身体成一条直线。
撑住目标时间，换另一侧。
steps_en: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your forearm on the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Hold for the target time, then switch sides.

exercises.name: superman
steps: 俯卧，双臂向前伸直。
同时抬起手臂和腿，胸口离地，臀腿收紧。
停 1–2 秒慢慢放下，不要猛甩。
steps_en: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Lift your arms and legs together, chest off the floor, squeezing your glutes.
Hold for 1-2 seconds, then lower slowly; don't swing.

exercises.name: crunch
steps: 仰卧屈膝，双手轻放耳侧或胸前。
用腹部把肩胛卷离地面，腰贴地。
慢慢放下，不要用手拉脖子。
steps_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulders off the ground, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse crunch
steps: 仰卧，双腿屈膝抬起，腰贴地。
用腹部把骨盆卷向胸口，臀部微微离地。
慢慢放下，不要借惯性。
steps_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs perpendicular to the floor.
Contract your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: mountain climber
steps: 俯卧撑起手位，身体成一条直线。
交替把膝盖往胸口收，速度按呼吸节奏。
保持髋部稳定，不要上下弹。
steps_en: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and your core engaged.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: high knees
steps: 站直，交替把膝盖抬到髋高。
前脚掌轻落地，手臂自然摆动。
按时间或次数做，喘得厉害就放慢。
steps_en: Stand tall and alternate driving your knees up to hip height.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and swing your arms naturally.
Go by time or reps; slow down if you're gasping.

exercises.name: cat cow
steps: 四点跪姿，手在肩下、膝在髋下。
吸气塌腰抬头，呼气拱背低头。
慢速来回，配合呼吸做 8–10 次。
steps_en: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale, drop your belly and lift your head; exhale, round your back and tuck your chin.
Move slowly with your breath for 8-10 reps.

exercises.name: hip flexor stretch
steps: 半跪姿，后腿膝盖垫软垫。
收紧臀部，把髋轻轻向前推，感觉后腿髋前侧拉长。
保持 20–30 秒，换另一侧，不要塌腰。
steps_en: Kneel in a half-kneeling position with a pad under the back knee.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and gently push your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, switch sides, and don't arch your lower back.

exercises.name: calf stretch
steps: 面墙站立，双手扶墙，一腿后撤、脚跟踩实。
前腿屈膝，重心前移，感觉后腿小腿拉长。
保持 20–30 秒，换另一侧。
steps_en: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step your right foot back, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your left knee and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight and your heel on the ground.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
